name: FormatCondition
description: The FormatCondition object represents a conditional format of a combo box or text box control and is a member of the FormatConditions collection.
remarks: Use the FormatConditions (index), where index is the index number of the conditional format, to return a FormatCondition object. Use the Add method to create a new conditional format. Use the Modify method to change one of the formats, or the Delete method to delete a format. Use the BackColor, Enabled, FontBold, FontItalic, FontUnderline, and ForeColor properties of the FormatCondition object to control the appearance of formatted combo box and text box controls.

properties.name: ForeColor
properties.description: Use the ForeColor property to specify the color for text in a control. Read/write Long.

properties.name: BackColor
properties.description: Gets or sets the interior color of the specified object. Read/write Long.

properties.name: FontBold
properties.description: Use the FontBold property to specify whether a font appears in a bold style in the following situations:

properties.name: FontItalic
properties.description: Use the FontItalic property to specify whether text is italic in the following situations:

properties.name: FontUnderline
properties.description: Use the FontUnderline property to specify whether text is underlined in the following situations:

properties.name: Enabled
properties.description: Use the Enabled property to set or return the status of the conditional format in the FormatCondition object. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns the value of a FormatCondition object type. Read-only AcFormatConditionType.

properties.name: Operator
properties.description: Use the Operator property to return the operator value for the conditional format or data validation of a FormatCondition object. Read-only AcFormatConditionOperator.

properties.name: Expression1
properties.description: Use the Expression1 property to return the values of a conditional format within a FormatCondition object. Read-only String.

properties.name: Expression2
properties.description: Use the Expression2 property to return the values of a conditional format within a FormatCondition object. Read-only String.

properties.name: ShortestBarLimit
properties.description: Gets or sets how the shortest data bar is evaluated for the specified FormatCondition. Read/write AcFormatBarLimits.

properties.name: ShortestBarValue
properties.description: Gets or sets a numeric expression that specifies the value of the shortest bar of a FormatCondition. Read/write String.

properties.name: LongestBarLimit
properties.description: Gets or sets how the longest data bar is evaluated for the specified FormatCondition. Read/write AcFormatBarLimits.

properties.name: LongestBarValue
properties.description: Gets or sets a numeric expression that specifies the value of the longest bar of a FormatCondition. Read/write String.

properties.name: ShowBarOnly
properties.description: Gets or sets whether the data bar or the data bar and its value are displayed. Set to True to display only the data bar. Read/write Boolean.

methods.name: Modify
methods.signature: Modify(Type As AcFormatConditionType, [Operator As AcFormatConditionOperator], [Expression1 As Variant], [Expression2 As Variant])
methods.description: Use the Modify method to change the format conditions of a FormatCondition object in the FormatConditions collection of a combo box or text box control.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: An AcFormatConditionType constant that specifies the type of condition to be modified.

parameters.name: Operator
parameters.description: An AcFormatConditionOperator constant that specifies the type of operator to be used. NOTE: If the type argument is acExpression, the operator argument is ignored. If you leave this argument blank, the default constant (acBetween) is assumed.

parameters.name: Expression1
parameters.description: A value or expression associated with the first part of the conditional format. Can be a constant value or a string value.

parameters.name: Expression2
parameters.description: A value or expression associated with the second part of the conditional format when the operator argument is acBetween or acNotBetween (otherwise, this argument is ignored). Can be a constant value or a string value.
